name: Mirrors
source:
Follow the story of Robin, a girl whose life has been cursed by a shadow that visited her when she was ten. After a tragic event, her visions began to go haywire.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
讲述罗宾的故事，她是一个女孩，她的生活被十岁时出现的阴影所诅咒。一场悲惨事件之后，她的愿景开始变得混乱。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
